units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:4">Pes. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Pesachim 48b:11">48ᵇ</cite>), v. <cite ref="L00398"><he>לָטַשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 91a:4-5">Sabb. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>הוציא … ותָפְחָה וכ׳</he> if he carried out (on the Sabbath) the size of half a dried fig, intending to sow it, and it swelled (to the size of a whole fig) &c., v. <cite ref="R00588"><he>צָמַק</he></cite>.
Tosef. Shebi. II, 14 כדי שיִתְפַּח in order that it (the dung) may swell (or become moist, v. תָּפַח III).
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 7:7">Mikv. VII, 7</cite> <he>כדי שיִתְפְּחוּ המים</he> that the water may rise in volume.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9<sup>21</sup></cite> <he>ויִתְפַּח צוארה</he> (not <he>ותפח</he>) and her throat shall swell.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 2:2:4">Y. Ter. II, 41ᵈ</cite> top <he>אתה רואה את הצמק כאילו ת׳</he> look upon the shrivelled fruit as if it were blown up (of full size).
Ib. לִתְפּוֹחַ, v. תֶּפַח; a. fr.—Part. pass. תָּפוּחַ round and smooth.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:4:4">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ראשו ת׳ כתורמוס</he> the head (of the embryo) is round and smooth as a lupine; <he>כקרקבן</he> as a bird’s maw.
